description_zh: 获取一个或者多个符合条件的 SAP HANA 备份计划
kebab_example: aliyun hbr describe-hana-backup-plans --vault-id v-000i4lg4kz000000ahl --cluster-id cl-000chxz000000lz7bk --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --database-name SYSTEMDB --resource-group-id rg-acfmvywqfey5njq --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHanaBackupPlans

parameters.name: cluster_id

The backup type.

COMPLETE: full backup.

DIFFERENTIAL: differential backup

INCREMENTAL：增量备份。

true：暂停

PlanId.description_en: The ID of the backup plan

PlanName.description_en: The name of the backup plan

Schedule.description_en:
The backup policy. Format: `I|{startTime}|{interval}`. The system runs the first backup job at a point in time that is specified by `{startTime}` and repeats the backup job at an interval that is specified by `{interval}`. The system does not run a backup job to compensate for a missed backup job. If a backup job is not complete, the next backup job is not triggered. For example, `I|1631685600|P1D` indicates that the system runs a backup job every day, starting from 2021-09-15 14:00:00.

startTime: The start time of the backup job. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

interval: The interval of the backup job. This value follows the ISO 8601 standard. For example, PT1H indicates that the backup job is run every hour. P1D indicates that the backup job is run every day
Schedule.description_zh:
备份策略。可选格式：`I|{startTime}|{interval}`。表示从{startTime}开始每隔{interval}的时间执行一次备份任务。不会补偿已过去时间的备份任务。如果上一次备份任务没有完成，不会触发下一次备份任务。例如`I|1631685600|P1D`表示从2021-09-15 14:00:00开始每隔一天备份一次。

startTime：备份起始时间，UNIX时间，单位为秒。
interval： ISO8601时间间隔。例如：PT1H表示间隔一小时。P1D表示间隔一天

VaultId.description_en: The ID of the backup vault
